Package org.geysermc.paletter.item

Class RegisteredItem

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.item.RegisteredItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.definitions.ItemDefinition, org.cloudburstmc.protocol.common.Definition, org.cloudburstmc.protocol.common.NamedDefinition
public final class RegisteredItem extends Object implements org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.definitions.ItemDefinition
An item definition in a compiled palette.

Instances are compared by identity, and are shared between a palette and every palette extending it, unless a layer overrides that item. So == between a definition from a shared palette and one from a session's palette is safe.

Since:
1.0.0

    • origin

      public @NonNull Origin origin()
      Returns:
      where this item comes from: vanilla, or the id of the layer that added it (an override keeps the origin of the item it changes)

    • key

      public @NonNull BedrockItemType key()
      Returns:
      the key of this item: the vanilla constant, or the custom type of its identifier

    • components

      public @NonNull List<ItemComponent> components()
      Returns:
      the components this item was given by a layer: those of a custom item, or the ones overrides set on top. Empty for vanilla items that nothing overrides

    • properties

      public @NonNull Properties properties()
      Returns:
      the properties of this item: its component data split the way the bundled property store names them (component:, wire:). For a vanilla item that is what the store holds for the palette's version; for a custom item or an overridden one it reflects the components the layers set

    • customItem

      public @Nullable CustomItem customItem()
      Returns:
      the custom item this was registered from, or null for vanilla items and items of custom blocks

    • isCustom

      public boolean isCustom()
      Returns:
      true if this item was added by a layer rather than being vanilla
